title: Home page
intro: The home page is the starting point: search the whole database, see how much it holds, and jump straight to a trait.

callouts.label: Menu
callouts.text: Every part of the database is one click away: Statistics, Map, Data, Search, Linkage maps, Publications, News and this Tutorial.

callouts.label: Search box
callouts.text: Type a QTL name, trait, marker, gene or author and press Search. The examples below it (Drought, Rht-B1, Fhb1 …) run a search in one click.

callouts.label: Quick links
callouts.text: Open the data tables, the Statistics page or the Genome map.

callouts.label: Live counts
callouts.text: The number of QTL, MetaQTL, epistatic QTL pairs, multi-trait QTL and species, read from the current data. Click a number to open that table.

callouts.label: Browse by trait
callouts.text: Each tile shows how many QTL the trait has and opens the Search page with that trait already selected.

title: Home page: browse by chromosome and news
intro: Further down the home page you can pick a chromosome, read what has changed recently and copy the citation.

callouts.label: Chromosome picker
callouts.text: The 21 chromosomes drawn at their relative lengths and coloured by subgenome. Click one to list all of its QTL.

callouts.label: News
callouts.text: Data releases and new features, most recent first. “All news” opens the full list.

title: Search
intro: Search combines free text with filters. Filters narrow the table as you set them, and the web address changes with them, so a search can be bookmarked or shared.

callouts.label: Free text
callouts.text: Matches QTL name, trait, parameter, marker, candidate gene, reference, cross and population.

callouts.label: Trait class
callouts.text: One of the five main traits. Choosing one limits the Trait list to its sub-categories.

callouts.label: Trait
callouts.text: A single trait, such as Drought tolerance or Fungal resistance. Biofortification and Nutrient use efficiency offer a further Sub-trait list.

callouts.label: Chromosome and species
callouts.text: Limit the results to one chromosome or one species.

callouts.label: PVE range
callouts.text: Keep only QTL whose phenotypic variance explained falls between a minimum and a maximum (in %).

callouts.label: Other filters
callouts.text: Show only QTL with a candidate gene, or only multi-trait (pleiotropic) QTL.

callouts.label: Result count
callouts.text: How many records match, out of the whole database, and which traits they belong to.

callouts.label: Export CSV
callouts.text: Downloads exactly the rows that match, with every column, for use in R, Python or Excel.

callouts.label: Reset
callouts.text: Clears every filter.

title: Data tables
intro: The Data page lists every table in the database. Each opens as a sortable, searchable table that can be exported.

callouts.label: QTL
callouts.text: All main effect QTL and marker–trait associations.

callouts.label: MetaQTL and epistatic QTL
callouts.text: Consensus QTL regions across studies, and QTL × QTL interactions.

callouts.label: Candidate genes
callouts.text: Every gene named as a candidate, linked to GrainGenes or Ensembl Plants.

callouts.label: GWAS Atlas associations
callouts.text: Marker–trait associations imported from GWAS Atlas. They are a separate table and are not part of the QTL counts.

callouts.label: Studies awaiting curation
callouts.text: Papers found in the literature that are not yet in the database.

title: Working with a table
intro: Every table works the same way, whether it is QTL, MetaQTL, candidate genes or publications.

callouts.label: Search the table
callouts.text: Filters the rows as you type, across all columns.

callouts.label: Row count
callouts.text: The number of rows currently shown.

callouts.label: Export CSV
callouts.text: Downloads the rows currently shown.

callouts.label: Sort and definitions
callouts.text: Click a column heading to sort by it; click again to reverse. Hover the small “?” for the definition of the column.

callouts.label: Reference
callouts.text: Opens the source publication. A dash means the source did not report that value.

title: Statistics
intro: The Statistics page summarises what the database holds. All numbers are computed from the current data when the page opens.

callouts.label: Totals
callouts.text: QTL, MetaQTL, epistatic QTL pairs and source publications.

callouts.label: Main traits
callouts.text: The five main traits with their totals. The bar length is proportional to the number of QTL.

callouts.label: Sub-categories
callouts.text: Each sub-category with its count and its share of all records. The rows add up to the total.

title: Statistics: charts
intro: Below the trait table are charts by chromosome and publication year, and summaries of position type, species and literature coverage.

callouts.label: QTL by chromosome
callouts.text: Bars are coloured by subgenome (A, B, D). Hover a bar to read its exact value.

callouts.label: Save a chart
callouts.text: Hover a chart and click the camera icon to save it as a high-resolution PNG.

callouts.label: QTL by publication year
callouts.text: The year of the study each QTL came from.

callouts.label: Type of map position
callouts.text: How many QTL have a physical position, a genetic position only, or none.

title: Genome map: Circos view
intro: The Map page draws QTL and MetaQTL on the wheat genome. The Circos view shows all 21 chromosomes in a circle.

callouts.label: Layers
callouts.text: Switch QTL, MetaQTL, GWAS Atlas associations and epistatic links on or off.

callouts.label: Choose the view
callouts.text: Ideogram and Circos show QTL with a physical position; Linkage (cM) shows QTL mapped only on a genetic map.

callouts.label: Export
callouts.text: Save the current view as SVG, PNG or JPEG. PNG and JPEG are saved at print resolution.

callouts.label: Search the map
callouts.text: Shows only the QTL whose name, trait, parameter or candidate gene matches.

callouts.label: Subgenome
callouts.text: Limit the view to the A, B or D subgenome.

callouts.label: Highlight traits
callouts.text: Click one or several traits to show only those. The colours here are the colours used in the plot.

callouts.label: The plot
callouts.text: Outer ring: chromosomes. Next ring: QTL density. Inner rings: one ring per trait for MetaQTL and for QTL. Hover any mark for its details.

title: Genome map: Ideogram view
intro: The Ideogram view lays the chromosomes side by side, each at its true physical length.

callouts.label: Chromosomes
callouts.text: Height is proportional to physical length; the pinch marks the centromere. The strip beside each chromosome shows QTL density, coloured by the most frequent trait, and the brackets are MetaQTL intervals.

title: Genome map: Linkage (cM) view
intro: Many QTL were published with a genetic-map position only. They cannot be placed on the physical views, so they are drawn here on a centimorgan scale.

callouts.label: How many are shown
callouts.text: The number of QTL drawn by their genetic position.

callouts.label: cM scale
callouts.text: Each strip is a 5 cM window: its length shows how many QTL were reported there and its colour the most frequent trait. Positions are as published, each on its own study’s map.

title: Linkage maps
intro: Genetic maps behind the mapped QTL: the GrainGenes catalogue plus maps whose marker positions can be viewed here.

callouts.label: Viewable maps
callouts.text: How many of the catalogued maps can be drawn with their marker positions.

callouts.label: Map viewer
callouts.text: One bar per linkage group; shading shows marker density. Click a group to list its markers.

callouts.label: Choose a map
callouts.text: Maps with marker positions are listed first; the others are catalogue records with a link to GrainGenes.

title: Publications
intro: Every study behind a record, with its title, authors, journal, year and the number of records it contributed.

callouts.label: Summary
callouts.text: The number of publications and the years they span.

callouts.label: Decade
callouts.text: Show only the publications of one decade.

callouts.label: Title
callouts.text: Opens the publication. The Records column shows how many records came from it.

title: Candidate genes
intro: Genes proposed as underlying a QTL, each with the link that suits its identifier.

callouts.label: Kind of identifier
callouts.text: Says whether the entry is a gene symbol, an annotation gene model or a functional description.

callouts.label: Resources
callouts.text: Gene symbols open in GrainGenes; gene models open in Ensembl Plants; a position opens the genome browser at that location.

title: Studies awaiting curation and News
intro: Papers found by a literature search that are not yet in the database. They are listed so that curators, and users, can see what is still to come; no QTL has been taken from them. New data and features are announced on the News page.

callouts.label: Strongest candidates
callouts.text: Tick to show only papers whose title reports QTL or GWAS work.

callouts.label: Study type
callouts.text: QTL mapping, GWAS, meta-QTL or epistatic QTL.

callouts.label: News
callouts.text: Opens the list of data releases and new features.
